column1: # kf.cleanliness - committed floors for the source cleanliness ratchet.
# RATCHET: down-only. Bless a lower number with `kf verify board --update`;
# a higher one is a regression and fails `kf verify board --gate`.
# Data inventory counts are informational and have no floors.
# Never hand-edit to raise a floor - reconstruct/name the symbol instead.
# Modern checking requires explicit casts at the SDK/libc void-pointer
# boundaries (AddPrim, SetSemiTrans, memcpy, memset, free, read, write,
# CdGetSector, InitHeap), as on SLPS-00017. The five void * views are
# GAME's malloc/free wrappers and the raw arena it formats.
